note: GDP per capita is expressed in [international-$](#dod:int_dollar_abbreviation) at 2021 prices.
title: Carbon intensity vs. GDP per capita
subtitle: Carbon intensity represents the quantity of CO₂ emitted per unit of [total energy supply](#dod:total-energy-supply), measured in grams of CO₂ per kilowatt-hour. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
